PSD and all three registered Harvey families; primary whitening uses minimum descriptive BIC. The published envelope location is contextual, not a tuning target.
Conventional echelle at the primary classical ACF spacing, with externally degree-identified Lund et al. modes. Folded row indices are not physical radial-order labels.
Localized finite path H0 classes. Their lifetimes equal elder-rule peak prominence exactly; the essential component is retained in the JSON but omitted from numeric summaries.

Spectral and cylindrical trial scans retain half, nominal, double and boundary alternatives. Cylindrical performance remains geometry-only under G8; a matching Rudy spacing cannot establish estimator utility.
Periodic cylindrical field and competing ridge-graph paths. Seam duplication is display-only. The paths lack a defensible degree anchor, so no topological frequency ratios are reported.
Rudy and actual TESS sectors placed against the registered simulation coordinates. This is domain context, not a calibrated inversion from simulated parameters to stellar properties.

All 72 registered branch/factor diagnostics. Red bars are monthly-estimator bootstrap intervals, gray bars registered pipeline ranges, and green crosses full-span points; their estimands differ and the components are not combined.

Quarter and cumulative-baseline diagnostics with the full-span background held fixed. Quarter scatter reflects realization plus window variation; cumulative points overlap and are not independent replicates.

Same-star Kepler degradation through all 11 real TESS windows, three source offsets, two durations/duty factors and three added-noise factors. Reused Kepler segments are correlated; actual TESS candidates remain unconfirmed under the Stage 3 thresholds.
